items.title: Why Is Fortinet (FTNT) Buying Into Continuous AI Runtime Security?
items.summary: Fortinet (NasdaqGS:FTNT) announced the acquisition of Virtue AI to support continuous AI runtime security for autonomous systems. The deal adds Virtue AI's continuous validation and real time protection tools to Fortinet's Security for AI strategy. Fortinet expects the Virtue AI technology to expand its security coverage across AI infrastructure and applications.
